gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo reads as a modern sans with a sizable x-height and curved letters whose mouths stay wide open. Azonix sits above it, horizontals matching verticals, firm and commanding.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Azonix looks drawn with a round-tipped pen, capitals barely taller than lowercase, so words take a moment to knit together. Noto Sans Sundanese keeps that going gently, its crossbars open.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Bent tubing, basically. Azonix stands commanding, its capitals barely above lowercase, while Noto Sans Sunuwar answers with curves that leave daylight and short, stubby ascenders.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac reads approachably, its tall lowercase bowls round as blown glass bulbs and its s shapes turning wide and easy. And Azonix, with no modulation between stems and connecting strokes, would keep its crispness if made small.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-syriac-ea: Noto Sans Syriac Eastern sets tall lowercase against small capitals, its curve endings keeping their distance from one another. And Azonix, wire-thick throughout, gives that friendly body a firm, authoritative lead.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-syriac-we: Modern and clean, this pairing starts with bundled-cable lowercase. Azonix is the one for commanding, pipe-cleaner-bent headlines, while Noto Sans Syriac Western keeps its terminals far from the stroke body and quietly carries the text.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Azonix is wide-mouthed and authoritative, with no thin strokes vanishing in glare. And Noto Sans Tagalog follows with a dense middle zone and generous gaps in its curves.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Noto Sans Tagbanwa fills most of its height with lowercase and keeps its curves open. Azonix, built like bent tubing of one gauge, leads with authority, and the body can be sized up or down freely.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le tapers its ink strokes out before they touch, with hardly any step from capital to lowercase. Azonix, unvarying in stroke thickness, shares that closeness of height and gives the pair its strength.
